title: Page presses, the Questions tab, the Answered row date, the failure line and folded titles fit their boxes at 180-260 px and 150-300% text
why: Lane page-narrow-word-breaks 15:19 CST Nov 12: on #2347's page the Dismiss, Restore, Reply and Send answers presses, the Questions tab, the Answered row date, the "(permission-denied)" failure line and folded titles overflow their boxes at 180-260 px, 150-300% text (Dismiss label 170 px in a 110 px press at 180 px, 300%) instead of breaking inside a word, so step page-narrow-word-breaks's premise does not hold for them.
note: Each named element stays inside its box at 180-260 px and 150-300% text (wrap, shrink or stack); a screen check per element red first on #2347's page. A screen lane: designer before the builder, design reviewer after. After #2982 merges.
